claude._verified: Selectors: 2026-10-13 signed-in capture. Models: platform.claude.com models overview + 'More models' list in claude.ai (Alex, 2026-10-14). Prices/efforts/status: provider docs via provider-facts.json. Plans: Fable 5/5.1 per support article 15424964 (Max: included, up to 50% of weekly usage; Pro: usage credits, not included; Free: not available); other plan memberships and plan prices are NOT verified from Anthropic.
claude._efforts: Ids are the Claude API effort values (platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort, 2026-10-14); which models accept which level comes from the same page. Labels: Alex sees Light/Medium/High/Extra high/Max in claude.ai (2026-10-14). outputMultiplier and fitDelta are Euboulia's own estimates of each level's effect; providers publish no figures.

chatgpt._verified: Selectors: logged out 2026-10-12. Chat picker: 'GPT-6' (powered by GPT-6 Sol), 'GPT-6 Pro' (GPT-6 Astra), GPT-5.6 Sol; Free/Go get GPT-5.6 Luna (help article 20001354). Work picker as seen signed in by Alex 2026-10-14: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna. Plan prices from the same help article (Plus $20; Pro $100 and $200); Go's price not read, so Go is omitted. Which Work models each plan includes is not fully documented: Plus includes Astra in Work and Codex; GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna are in Work for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise.
chatgpt._efforts: Ids are the OpenAI API reasoning.effort values (developers.openai.com model pages, 2026-10-14). ChatGPT Work/Codex label them Light, Medium, High, Extra High, Max (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models); Chat shows Instant, Medium, High, Extra High and Pro (help.openai.com article 20001354, ~2026-10-10). 'Pro' in Chat is GPT-6 Pro = GPT-6 Astra, modelled as a model alias. Ultra (subagents) is not an effort level. outputMultiplier and fitDelta are Euboulia's own estimates of each level's effect; providers publish no figures.
